newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish 6 bln SKR T-bill auction oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Swedish 6 bln SKR T-bill auction oversubscribed.

text.p: Sweden's auction of six billion crowns worth of Treasury bills was oversubscribed, the National Debt Office said on Wednesday.
The average accepted rate in an auction of six-month T-bills was 4.94 percent, the office said.
The office had invited bids for a total 1.2 billion crowns and received 26 bids worth 7.5 billion crowns. It accepted nine bids.
The average accepted rate in an auction of one-year T-bills was 5.25 percent, the office said.
The office had invited bids for a total of 4.8 billion crowns and received 91 bids worth 17.18 billion crowns. It accepted 24 bids.
